About This Game


A mountain of bunnies. A place for every one of them.

Sort the Bunnies is a cozy first-person organizing simulator. Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op, turning a shop full of scattered toys into colorful collections.

Find a match in the pile, carry it to its shelf, and fill that last empty space. Bring matching bunnies together and watch a cluttered shop become a display worth admiring.



Share the shop with up to three friends in online co-op. Split up the sorting, help each other find missing bunnies, or take a break for a completely unnecessary toy fight.



Earn coins as you sort and spend them on a helping hand. Carry more, reach farther, reveal matching bunnies, and collect nearby matches into your basket.



Line up the claw, make your grab, and see what comes out. Take a break from the shelves to win temporary powers and playful accessories for your bunny.



Unlock the bunny-ear hoop and turn tidying into target practice. Land a bunny through the hoop and watch it fly to its shelf. A little aim goes a long way.



Use the pump to puff up a giant version of your favorite bunny. Keep pumping and watch it grow right in front of you. That should be big enough… probably.



Start a toy tower on a friend's head and see how ridiculous it can get. Between the sorting and the flying bunnies, there's always time for one more questionable idea.



Give your favorite bunny a moment in the spotlight. Watch its tiny family pop out of a hat and put on a show at the miniature theatre before you head back to the shelves.



Meet 500 bunny designs across 20 themed collections, from sweet treats and tiny tea cups to space explorers. With 5,000 toys to sort, there's plenty to find—and plenty of satisfying gaps to fill.


AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

We use generative AI across all disciplines of game development most often with heavy amounts of human editing. That involves audio and visual art, our store assets, and localization. We use it as a productivity tool so we can achieve a higher level of quality, faster, than we would have been able to.
